title: Encrypt the Mempool #0, February 18, 2026
summary: Two-slot execution design: encrypted tx (block N) + decrypted tx (block N+1) Execution context references previous block to prevent builder communication Envelope signer reference added to prevent envelope stripping attacks EIP-8105 PR merged yesterday with all new changes Encrypted tx consumes all gas; decrypted tx consumes none Gas charged at block N prices for execution in block N+1 Builder knows next block base f
